reviews.title: Cancelled Subscription
reviews.text: Bought this in August 26. Thought it was a fabulous app. Two months later and the developers have made it more complicated to use. For me that is a loss of 10 months use. More clicks to get to the style of brush or marker etc. I have more complex art apps. I loved this because of its ease of use. I have paid for a couple of months use and now it’s changed.  I have contacted the developers and there is no way to return to the version I purchased.  I am really disappointed. I am thoroughly fed up with paying for apps and them being perfectly useable only for them to be updated and made far more complicated to use.  Subscription cancelled.

reviews.title: Not Just Expensive...Also Glitchy!
reviews.text: Started the free trial to see if it was worth $40 a year to me. Art looks cute, and we love supporting artists. Started coloring one image, and after coloring about 1/3 of the picture, I hit undo to go back *one step* and instead had it erase half my picture. Tried to restart the photo...that's greyed out. Tried another picture and the same thing happened. The audacity you've gotta have to charge money for an app that doesn't work properly is astounding.

reviews.text:
And I mean A LOT of really, really, really ugly pictures. There are ones I wish I could hide since I’ll never color them. Idk the process for artists to have their work on here, but it really wouldn’t hurt to branch out and find new artists and other art styles.

I decided to pay for the subscription, but the color palettes need a massive overhaul. 

They’re boring. Sure, yeah, we can pick other colors, but the pre-created palettes need additions. There should be palettes for each season and holiday (that don’t disappear). More pastels, neons, and monochromatic palettes would be great.

reviews.title: New Update: Search Feature, Collections, Artist Pages
reviews.text: I was very excited about the new update when it was announced we would be able to view artist pages, have search functionality, and get access to new tools. However, as I’ve recognized in many of these “updates”, hardly any of the features work. I cannot view artist pages—when I search by artist name, exactly as they are listed, nothing comes up, and when I click on the artist page directly from a template, nothing loads. A simple search of “patterns”, “Christmas”, or “holiday”—no search results available. Collections also seem to be a thing of the past now. I’ve been using this app for years at this point, and I’m always disappointed by the bugs. These features should not be announced or implemented if not even half of those announced in the update are viable, especially for the annual price of this app.
